newsitem.title: USA: Clinton team offers muted reaction to rate rise.
newsitem.headline: Clinton team offers muted reaction to rate rise.

text.p: President Bill Clinton's top economic advisers said after the Federal Reserve raised a key interest rate on Tuesday that the administration respected the Fed's independence and was confident the U.S. economy will continue to grow.

"The administration recognizes and respects the independence or the Federal Reserve in making decisions about the nation's monetary policy," Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin and Chairwoman Janet Yellen of the Council of Economic Advisers said in a joint statement. "We share the goal of maintaining solid economic growth with low inflation."
